title: Enfermeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Enfermeiro em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga:

Enfermeiro(a) na Alemanha

Salário:

• +R$14.500,00 (+2.500 euros — inicial) + benefícios.

Localidade:

• Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)

Programa:

• Enfermanha - Enfermagem na Alemanha, da Sprache& Wissen.

Como funciona?

• Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), estuda alemão por até 2 anos até atingir o nível B2 (intermediário completo). Você escolhe onde estudar — na escola da Sprache& Wissen (maior online de alemão da América Latina) ou em outra instituição validada. Concluída a etapa de estudos, dentro dos requisitos do programa, a S& W te conecta com sua oportunidade profissional na Alemanha.

Quem é a Sprache& Wissen?

• A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.

Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

• Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico

• Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos

• Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão

• Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador

Requisitos:

• Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil

• Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão)

title: Electrical engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Electrical engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

You have built solid experience in high-voltage engineering and you are ready to take full technical ownership of primary system design on projects that sit at the heart of the energy transition. If working on complex HV infrastructure for a technically leading organisation in Europe interests you, this role is worth your full attention. Company Information Our client is a recognised leader in the design, implementation, and management of high-voltage systems in the Netherlands. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainable energy strategy, they work at the forefront of grid enhancement and energy transition projects across the sector. Their engineering teams bring deep technical expertise to primary HV systems and the civil and structural solutions required to support them. This is a technically driven organisation where quality, precision, and engineering integrity are central to everything they deliver. Vacancy Information As an Electrical Engineer, your focus sits firmly in the domain of high-voltage primary systems and the supporting structures required for the installation and mounting of HV components. This includes power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, current and voltage instrument transformers, cable and overhead line connections, and all associated civil and structural support arrangements. You will take full responsibility from basic design through detailed design and on to execution and project delivery. You will translate functional requirements into concrete technical solutions, prepare and review engineering documentation, and support the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager across all project phases. When design bottlenecks arise, you identify and resolve them. When quality checks are needed, you perform them. This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership and direct involvement from the earliest design stages through to final delivery. Key Responsibilities Translating functional designs and client requirements into concrete technical designs and project plans for HV primary systems. Designing and verifying integrated solutions based on client specifications, applicable technical standards including IEC and ABNT, and relevant laws and regulations. Preparing and reviewing technical documentation, engineering drawings, calculations, and execution documents across all project phases. Supporting the Lead Engineer and Technical Manager from basic design in the preparation phase through to detailed execution design. Identifying and resolving design bottlenecks, reporting findings to the wider project team, and performing quality checks on deliverables. Working closely with civil, structural, and electrical disciplines to ensure that primary component installations are fully integrated and constructible. What You Need Bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Power Engineering, or a comparable technical field. Solid experience in high-voltage primary system design, with working knowledge of HV components such as power transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, and instrument transformers including CTs and VTs. Familiarity with HV substation layouts, overhead line connections, cable termination arrangements, and supporting civil and structural requirements. Understanding of applicable technical standards and design codes relevant to high-voltage systems including IEC standards. Familiarity with ABNT NBR requirements is considered an advantage. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to develop and verify integrated technical solutions under project conditions. A proactive and results-oriented mindset with the drive to deliver quality outcomes for both the project and your own professional development. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Willingness to learn Dutch and integrate into a Dutch working environment is expected and will be an important part of settling into the team successfully. If you do not meet every requirement but have a strong background in high-voltage engineering and a genuine interest in primary system design, we still encourage you to apply. The right combination of technical experience, motivation, and willingness to grow can make you a strong candidate. Relocation This position is based in the Netherlands and will require relocation. We understand that making an international move is a significant decision and we are here to make that process as straightforward as possible. As part of your contract, Fair Play Engineering provides a Premium Relocation Package. This includes visa sponsorship, guidance before your move, and dedicated support from a relocation consultant throughout the process. You can find more information on the Relocating with us page on our website. Apply We appreciate every application we receive. Because this is a specialised role, we will contact candidates whose experience closely matches the requirements. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has unfortunately not been selected for the next step. Fair Play Engineering specialises in recruiting engineers for roles in the Netherlands. If this vacancy is not the right match for you, keep an eye on our vacancies page for future opportunities.

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.

What you'll do

Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we're looking for

We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow).

Nice to have (not required)

Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Digital analytics/ tracking engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital analytics/ tracking engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Tracking Engineer / Digital Analytics Engineer

We are looking for a Tracking Engineer to own end-to-end analytics implementation across a complex, global digital ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of business, data, and engineering, ensuring accurate, scalable, and high‐quality measurement across web, mobile, OTT, and emerging platforms.

Key Skills

• Strong hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager

• Advanced Java Script skills with the ability to read, understand, and enhance existing code

• Solid knowledge of digital analytics platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and tag management tools including Tealium and Adobe Launch

Responsibilities

• Translate business questions into detailed tracking and measurement specifications across web, mobile apps, OTT devices, gaming consoles, and Smart TVs

• Enable meaningful analysis of user experience and audience behavior across global digital properties

• Ensure all new and existing products and features are accurately measured, validated, and reported across devices

• Validate third-party tracking implementations such as com Score and Nielsen for each release

• Create, analyze, and QA reports to ensure data is populating correctly

• Communicate clearly with analytics platform users on how to retrieve and interpret data

• Work independently on time-sensitive and business‐critical analytics projects

• Maintain and create documentation including data layers, event inventories, and tracking specifications

• Own end-to-end delivery of analytics implementation projects, from design through deployment and QA

• Perform data quality audits, identify tracking gaps, and implement corrective improvements

• Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, vendors, and application development teams

• Provide thought leadership on standardizing data collection across a global environment

• Drive prioritization and resolution of tracking bugs, enhancements, and measurement issues

• Manage releases and ensure successful tracking deployment and validation in fast-paced environments

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree preferred (STEM a plus, not required)

• 2+ years of experience in analytics implementation or relevant internship experience

• Strong familiarity with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Tealium, Adobe Launch, or similar tools

• Highly autonomous, self‐starter mindset with excellent time management skills

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Strong analytical, problem‐solving, and creative thinking capabilities

• Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non‐technical audiences

• Curiosity-driven mindset with a passion for learning and continuous improvement

Additional Qualifications (Nice to Have)

• Experience in data analytics, data quality, data warehousing, data governance, business intelligence, data visualization, or data privacy

• Hands-on coding experience with Java, Python, or similar languages

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence

• Advanced experience deploying analytics through tag management systems

• Deep implementation expertise with Adobe Analytics or similar enterprise platforms

• Experience leading or influencing analytics architecture across multiple sites and distributed teams

• Demonstrated initiative to stay current with evolving analytics and tracking technologies

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. title: Ruby on rails developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ruby on rails developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.

THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.

You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments) Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity

BONUS POINTS

Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations) Tech stack: React, Postgre SQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations) Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale Participate in on-call rotations (Pager Duty) and help improve team processes Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams

YOUR IMPACT

Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.

EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.

Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.

Tasks and responsibilities:

Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;

Profile:

Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);

Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

description:

Para se candidatar, preencha o formulário: Wr B1wdp28 NOSSO JEITO DE SER E FAZER

O time da Pay Conductor é feito por pessoas obcecadas por resolver problemas reais de pagamentos: gente que entende que cada décimo de ponto na taxa de aprovação representa milhões na ponta dos nossos clientes.

Acreditamos que orquestração não é só tecnologia, é devolver às empresas o controle sobre o seu próprio dinheiro. Construímos uma plataforma AI-driven que conecta adquirentes, gateways e meios de pagamento em uma única camada inteligente, e estamos só começando.

Se você quer fazer parte do time que está redefinindo a infraestrutura de pagamentos do Brasil, é aqui.

E aí, quer construir o futuro dos pagamentos com a gente? SOBRE A VAGA

O time de Marketing da Pay Conductor é responsável por traduzir uma plataforma técnica e robusta em uma marca desejada por empreendedores digitais, varejistas, e-commerces e líderes do mercado financeiro.

A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca.

Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual.

Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

title: Product owner
description:

Product Owner – Client Onboarding & Customer Success

Remote (Brazil-based) | Supporting UK & US stakeholders | 8,000 - 10,000 BRL

We're proud to be partnering with an innovative, fast-growing Saa S business that is transforming how organisations deliver professional online auction experiences under their own brand. Owning the end-to-end onboarding journey from sales handover to go-live Acting as a trusted partner to clients, supporting early use and best practice Gathering and defining technical and operational requirements Collaborating with engineering to ensure smooth configuration and delivery Testing new features and ensuring releases are client-ready Feeding real client insight back into the product roadmap

Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Saa S Implementation specialist A strong track record in customer success, onboarding, or client-facing roles Ability to translate client needs into structured product requirements Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams Highly organised, proactive, and confident managing multiple stakeholders Exposure to B2 B Saa S, Agile environments, or platform-based products would be highly advantageous.

Join a scaling, globally-focused Saa S business at an exciting stage of growth Work directly with an experienced and passionate leadership team Have real influence over product direction and client success Fully remote role with international collaboration Be instrumental in shaping how clients experience and succeed with the platform

If you're a product-minded professional who thrives on solving real client problems and driving meaningful outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

First Ignite develops AI-powered tools designed to support universities in key areas such as Tech Transfer, Corporate Relations, Advancement, Career Development, and Research Development. These tools empower universities to expand their initiatives and streamline operations effectively. First Ignite is dedicated to helping academic institutions grow and thrive through innovative technological solutions, making a meaningful impact in the education sector.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer, will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems focused on acquiring, structuring, and integrating diverse datasets from external and internal sources. This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for First Ignite's platform.

Qualifications

Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources. Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (Py Spark), Lambda, S3, and RDS Postgre SQL. Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed. Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale. Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems. Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation. Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities. Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.

Requirements

Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines. Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/Py Spark, Lambda, S3, RDS Postgre SQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks. Strong experience with external data acquisition, including building and maintaining crawlers, scrapers, API integrations, and data mining workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into reliable, structured datasets. This includes handling rate limits, source changes, deduplication, validation, enrichment, and pipeline monitoring. Familiarity with RESTful and Graph QL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies. Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications. Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods. Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in Saa S or tech environments. Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar). LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output. Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

As part of your Linked In application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of.

Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Enfermeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Enfermeiro em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga:

Enfermeiro(a) na Alemanha

Salário:

• +R$14.500,00 (+2.500 euros — inicial) + benefícios.

Localidade:

• Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)

Programa:

• Enfermanha - Enfermagem na Alemanha, da Sprache& Wissen.

Como funciona?

• Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), estuda alemão por até 2 anos até atingir o nível B2 (intermediário completo). Você escolhe onde estudar — na escola da Sprache& Wissen (maior online de alemão da América Latina) ou em outra instituição validada. Concluída a etapa de estudos, dentro dos requisitos do programa, a S& W te conecta com sua oportunidade profissional na Alemanha.

Quem é a Sprache& Wissen?

• A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.

Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

• Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico

• Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos

• Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão

• Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador

Requisitos:

• Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil

• Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão)

• Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários

• Comprometimento com as etapas do programa

• Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)

Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível)

• Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico

• Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado

Sobre o período de estudos:

• Você estuda alemão do Brasil enquanto se prepara para a mudança

• Mentoria em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2

• Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual

Etapas do processo:

1. Inscrição e triagem inicial

2. Reunião com o time da S& W

3. Questionários e aprovação

4. Planejamento de estudos

5. Curso de alemão (até o nível B2)

6. Match com recrutador alemão

7. Colocação profissional na Alemanha

Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados, desenvolvendo pipelines escaláveis e garantindo a disponibilidade de informações críticas para o negócio.

Você trabalhará com grandes volumes de dados transacionais, contribuindo para a qualidade, confiabilidade e performance das soluções que apoiam áreas estratégicas da empresa. Procuramos alguém com perfil hands-on, senso de ownership e interesse em atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais de engenharia de dados e alto impacto no negócio.

Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Python, Py Spark e SQL. Construir e evoluir fluxos de ingestão de dados baseados em eventos e streaming. Implementar transformações, deduplicação e tratamento de dados nas camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold. Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados processados. Criar e otimizar tabelas e visões analíticas para consumo por dashboards e aplicações de negócio. Trabalhar com armazenamento em Parquet e ambientes S3-compatible. Colaborar com times de Produto, Compliance, Tesouraria e Tecnologia na construção de soluções orientadas a dados.

Requisitos

Experiência prática atuando como Engenheiro(a) de Dados ou em funções equivalentes. Domínio de Python aplicado à engenharia de dados. Conhecimento sólido de SQL avançado. Experiência com Apache Spark / Py Spark para processamento e transformação de dados. Vivência com arquiteturas de dados em camadas (Bronze, Silver e Gold). Experiência trabalhando com arquivos Parquet e armazenamento em nuvem ou object storage. Conhecimento de Docker e noções práticas de Kubernetes. Experiência com testes automatizados, versionamento Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Experiência com mensageria e streaming de dados, especialmente Kafka ou tecnologias similares.

Experiência com Protobuf e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

Modalidade: Remoto

Contratação: PJ

Total Pass – sua saúde física é importante!
